scripts.dev: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh && ln -sf /root/.deno/bin/deno /usr/local/bin/deno); deno run -A dev.ts
scripts.build: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh && ln -sf /root/.deno/bin/deno /usr/local/bin/deno); deno run -A build.ts
